en.headline: Silence Wang opens three-night Kai Tak Stadium residency tonight
en.dek: Mainland singer-songwriter Wang Sulong begins his Age of Romance world tour Hong Kong stop with the first of three shows at the new stadium, featuring a large-scale stage production.
body: Chinese singer-songwriter Silence Wang, also known as Wang Sulong, opens a three-night run at Kai Tak Stadium this evening as part of his Age of Romance world tour.

The concerts, scheduled for 4 to 6 September at 7pm, mark one of the early major music residencies at the new stadium. The production includes a nine-metre robot, an 80-metre curved LED screen and multiple lifting platforms.

Tickets remain available through official channels including HK Ticketing and Trip.com, with prices ranging from HK$380 to HK$1,680. The shows follow earlier mainland and regional dates on the same tour.

zh.headline: 汪蘇瀧今晚啟德體育場展開三場演唱會
zh.dek: 內地歌手汪蘇瀧「明日世界」世界巡迴演唱會香港站今晚起一連三晚於啟德體育場舉行，舞台製作包括巨型機械人及大型升降螢幕。
body: 內地唱作歌手汪蘇瀧今晚起在啟德體育場展開「明日世界」世界巡迴演唱會香港站，一連三晚於晚上7時開場。
演唱會為新體育場較早的大型音樂駐場演出之一，舞台設有九米高機械人、八十米闊弧形LED升降螢幕及多組升降裝置。
門票仍可於快達票及Trip.com等官方渠道購買，票價由380港元至1,680港元。是次香港站接續巡演其他內地及海外場次。
